name: UI：F88 落库配置
description: 打开策略详情页，验证落库配置区域存在，检查字段映射入口和文案，点击配置按钮验证弹窗。

steps.description: 验证策略列表页已加载
点击第一条策略的打开按钮
验证落库配置区域标题存在
验证已映射字段计数文案

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (const b of btns) { const txt = b.textContent.replace(/\s/g, ''); if (txt === '配置' && b.offsetHeight > 0) { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.y > 300) { return { x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2, found: true }; } } } return { found: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (const b of btns) { const txt = b.textContent.replace(/\s/g, ''); if (txt === '配置' && b.offsetHeight > 0) { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.y > 300) { b.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待落库配置弹窗/抽屉

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (modal) return { type: 'modal', title: modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-title')?.textContent.trim() }; if (drawer) return { type: 'drawer', title: drawer.querySelector('.ant-drawer-title')?.textContent.trim() }; return { type: 'none' }; })()
steps.description: 检查落库配置 UI 类型
